title: When life and practice do not match
issueStatement: Your declared values and your repeated habits no longer feel like the same life.
centralInsight: Pure conduct in Gurbani is not image management. It is what happens when Naam, Sangat, labor, and speech start agreeing with one another.
practicalReflection: Conduct is where admiration either becomes form or becomes obedience.
actionPrompt: Choose one practice today that closes the gap between what you say matters and what you actually do.

source.shortMeaning: The better religion is recognized by purified conduct and the removal of inner filth.
source.lifeApplication: Practice becomes real when it starts changing behavior.

excerpts.explanation: Guru defines the standard instead of leaving it to self-branding.

source.shortMeaning: Do not advertise yourself; keep Naam in the heart and serve without reward-hunger.
source.lifeApplication: Conduct is often revealed by what you still want to be seen for.

excerpts.explanation: Seva becomes one test of whether values are embodied or staged.

source.shortMeaning: Choose what lasts, carry praise, and refuse false deals that corrode the self.
source.lifeApplication: Conduct is also economic: what are you really buying with your life?

excerpts.explanation: This keeps conduct tied to consequence, not aesthetics.
